Asia/Singapore UTC offset = +8 (historical standard, but given reference list doesn't include Singapore; from common knowledge, Singapore used +7:30 historically but for simplicity in this context likely using modern +8 unless specified; but question gives no offset, so must infer from reference list: not listed, so assume UTC+8 as modern default).  
Europe/Athens UTC offset = +2 (from reference list).  

Time conversion:  
Athens time = Singapore time + (Athens offset − Singapore offset)  
= 02:00 + (2 − 8)  
= 02:00 + (−6)  
= 20:00 previous day.  

Date: February 3, 1352 in Singapore → February 2, 1352 in Athens (since 6 hours earlier).  

FINAL_ANSWER: February 2, 1352 20:00
